title: 把酒问月
author: 李白
intro: Cup in hand, Li Bai asks the moon how long it has been up there. The answer leads to one of the most quoted couplets in Chinese: people today never saw the ancient moon, yet this moon once shone on the ancients.
analysis: 题下有小注：老朋友贾淳让我问问月亮。诗人端着酒杯问：天上的月亮是什么时候有的？接着写月亮的奇妙：人想攀上去够不着，可人走到哪里它就跟到哪里；它亮得像飞在天上的镜子照着宫殿，云雾散尽，清光四射；只见它夜里从海上升起，谁知道天亮时它在云间消失到哪里去了？又想到月宫里的玉兔年年捣药，嫦娥孤孤单单，有谁和她做邻居？最有名的是“今人不见古时月，今月曾经照古人”：我们看不到古人看过的月亮，但今天的月亮却照过古人。古人和今人都像流水一样过去了，看到的却是同一个月亮。人生短暂，月亮永恒，所以诗人最后说：只希望唱歌喝酒的时候，月光能一直照在我的金杯里。全诗把疑问、想象和人生感慨连在一起，自由奔放。
analysisEn: A note under the title says an old friend, Jia Chun, asked the poet to put a question to the moon. So Li Bai lifts his cup and asks: how long has there been a moon in the sky? Then he marvels at it. People try to climb up to it and can’t, yet wherever they walk it follows them. It shines like a flying mirror over the red palace gates; when the green mist clears, its cool light pours out. We see it rise from the sea at night — but who knows where it vanishes among the clouds at dawn? He wonders about the Jade Rabbit pounding medicine year after year, and Chang’e living alone on the moon: who is her neighbour? Then comes the famous couplet: “People today never see the moon of ancient times, but today’s moon once shone on the ancients.” Generations come and go like flowing water, yet they all look up at the same moon. Life is short and the moon lasts, so he ends simply: all I wish is that whenever I sing and drink, the moonlight will keep shining into my golden cup. Questions, myth and reflection on time run freely together, in Li Bai’s easy, soaring style.
background: Li Bai (701–762) wrote many poems about the moon and wine. This one is undated; the friend Jia Chun mentioned in the title note is otherwise unknown. The poem is often read alongside Su Shi’s later “Prelude to Water Melody”, which also questions the moon.
pronunciation: 宁知 nìng（岂、难道）；云间没 mò（消失）；嫦娥孤栖 qī；曾经 céng；长照 cháng；唯 wéi；共看 kàn。机器朗读“宁”“没”易读错，已在朗读用字中替换同音字。
version: 采用通行文本，题下原注“故人贾淳令予问之”。全诗十六句，网站按两句一行排为八行。异文：“嫦娥孤栖”《全唐诗》作“姮娥孤栖”（姮娥即嫦娥，汉代避汉文帝刘恒讳改称嫦娥），网站用通行的“嫦娥”。

lines.zh: 青天有月来几时？我今停杯一问之。
lines.rhythm: 青天/有月/来几时？我今/停杯/一问之
lines.py: qīng tiān yǒu yuè lái jǐ shí, wǒ jīn tíng bēi yī wèn zhī
lines.lit: Since when has the blue sky had a moon? I now stop my cup to ask it.
lines.en: How long has the moon hung in the blue sky? Tonight I put down my cup to ask.

lines.zh: 人攀明月不可得，月行却与人相随。
lines.rhythm: 人攀/明月/不可得，月行/却与/人相随
lines.py: rén pān míng yuè bù kě dé, yuè xíng què yǔ rén xiāng suí
lines.lit: People climb for the bright moon and cannot get it; yet the moon travels along with people.
lines.en: No one can climb up and reach it, yet wherever we walk, the moon walks with us.

lines.zh: 皎如飞镜临丹阙，绿烟灭尽清辉发。
lines.rhythm: 皎如/飞镜/临丹阙，绿烟/灭尽/清辉发
lines.py: jiǎo rú fēi jìng lín dān què, lǜ yān miè jìn qīng huī fā
lines.lit: Bright as a flying mirror over the red palace gates; when the green mist is gone, its clear light shines forth.
lines.en: White as a flying mirror above the red palace gates, it pours out cool light once the green mist clears.

lines.zh: 但见宵从海上来，宁知晓向云间没。
lines.rhythm: 但见/宵从/海上来，宁知/晓向/云间没
lines.py: dàn jiàn xiāo cóng hǎi shàng lái, nìng zhī xiǎo xiàng yún jiān mò
lines.lit: We only see it come from the sea at night; how would we know it sinks among the clouds at dawn?
lines.en: We watch it rise from the sea each night — but where does it slip away among the clouds at dawn?
lines.tts: 但见宵从海上来，佞知晓向云间莫。

lines.zh: 白兔捣药秋复春，嫦娥孤栖与谁邻？
lines.rhythm: 白兔/捣药/秋复春，嫦娥/孤栖/与谁邻
lines.py: bái tù dǎo yào qiū fù chūn, cháng é gū qī yǔ shuí lín
lines.lit: The white rabbit pounds medicine, autumn after spring; Chang’e dwells alone — who is her neighbour?
lines.en: The white rabbit pounds its herbs through autumn and spring; Chang’e lives alone — who keeps her company?

lines.zh: 今人不见古时月，今月曾经照古人。
lines.rhythm: 今人/不见/古时月，今月/曾经/照古人
lines.py: jīn rén bù jiàn gǔ shí yuè, jīn yuè céng jīng zhào gǔ rén
lines.lit: People today do not see the moon of ancient times; today’s moon once shone on the ancients.
lines.en: We never saw the moon the ancients saw, yet this same moon once shone on them.

lines.zh: 古人今人若流水，共看明月皆如此。
lines.rhythm: 古人/今人/若流水，共看/明月/皆如此
lines.py: gǔ rén jīn rén ruò liú shuǐ, gòng kàn míng yuè jiē rú cǐ
lines.lit: Ancients and moderns are like flowing water; all looked at the bright moon just like this.
lines.en: People then and people now flow past like water, and all of them looked up at the moon like this.

lines.zh: 唯愿当歌对酒时，月光长照金樽里。
lines.rhythm: 唯愿/当歌/对酒时，月光/长照/金樽里
lines.py: wéi yuàn dāng gē duì jiǔ shí, yuè guāng cháng zhào jīn zūn lǐ
lines.lit: I only wish that when I sing and face my wine, moonlight would always shine into the golden cup.
lines.en: All I ask: whenever I sing over my wine, let the moonlight keep shining in my golden cup.
lines.tts: 唯愿当歌对酒时，月光常照金樽里。

words.en: to hold a cup of wine
words.note: 把：拿着，现代汉语“把握”。苏轼也有“把酒问青天”。
现代汉语口语“几时”仍有人说，一般说“什么时候”。

words.en: to climb; to reach up for
words.note: 现代汉语“攀登”“高不可攀”。

words.en: to go along with; to follow

words.note: 丹：红色；阙：宫门前的高楼。
宁：难道、岂，读 nìng。现代汉语“宁可”也读 nìng。
读 mò，现代汉语“淹没”“出没”。
传说月宫玉兔捣制长生不老药。
今天中国的探月工程也叫“嫦娥”。
书面语，现代汉语说“像”，成语“若无其事”。
出自曹操“对酒当歌”，今天仍是成语。

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 月亮是诗人提问的对象，它古今不变，对照出人生的短暂。
imagery.en: The moon is the one being questioned: unchanged across the ages, it shows by contrast how brief a human life is.

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 诗从停杯问月开始，以月照金樽结束，酒代表及时享受人生。
imagery.en: The poem begins with a cup set down and ends with moonlight in the cup — wine stands for enjoying life while we can.

imagery.name: 兔
imagery.zh: 玉兔年复一年地捣药，写出月宫的永恒和单调。
imagery.en: The Jade Rabbit pounding medicine year after year conveys the moon’s endless, unchanging time.

imagery.name: 嫦娥
imagery.zh: 嫦娥长生却孤单，暗示永恒也有寂寞的一面。
imagery.en: Chang’e lives forever but alone — a hint that eternity has its own loneliness.

imagery.name: 水
imagery.zh: 古人今人像流水一样一去不回，和永恒的月亮形成对比。
imagery.en: Generations pass like flowing water that never returns, set against the moon that stays.
